cheap_arm_hallucination.explanation: Cheap evaluation wrongly crowns balanced-13b first (56.8182% pass rate under all_low), but under the all_high gold standard balanced-13b is #2 of 5 at 62.6263%; the true winner is thorough-32b at 71.9697%. Measuring every task cheaply flips the top of the leaderboard.

cost_rank_tradeoff.interpretation: The allocated arm cuts evaluation cost by 56.79% versus the all_high gold standard (20.3497 USD / 11,375,912 tokens -> 8.7925 USD / 11,375,786 tokens) and moves top-3 rank stability by -31.66%.

headline: Cost down 56.79%, top-3 rank stability changes -31.66% versus the all_high gold standard. Measured cheaply, the leaderboard wrongly crowns balanced-13b first.

methodology.pass_rate: 100 * passed / evaluated, rounded to 4 dp before ranking
methodology.leaderboard_order: pass_rate descending, then total_cost_usd ascending, then model name ascending (deterministic, no exceptions)
methodology.arm_cost: total_tokens and total_cost_usd are math.fsum over the arm's records, so they are independent of record order
methodology.kendall_tau: Kendall tau-b = (C - D) / sqrt((n0 - n1) * (n0 - n2)), n0 = n(n-1)/2, n1/n2 = pairs tied on each side; None for <2 common models or a zero denominator
methodology.stability_pct: 100 * (0.5 * top3_membership_overlap_ratio + 0.5 * (kendall_tau + 1)/2); falls back to 100 * overlap_ratio when kendall_tau is undefined
